# Expected-failing CPython Lib/test test ids for the L3 harness (tests/py/run.py l3).
# Format: one test id per line, e.g. test_int.IntTestCases.test_basic, sorted.
# Ids drop the leading "test." package prefix; a bare module name means the module
# failed to import or crashed. Lines starting with '#' are comments and are preserved.
# Maintained by `tests/py/run.py l3 -u` (make testpy-update); do not edit by hand.
